title: Invoice Payment Record Relief on No-Show Charges — Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
## Credit policy clause

For the settlement of the no-show charge on a missed Mobile In-Home Collection Visit of Specimen Collection Appointments, the relief for the patient's invoice payment record is set by the payments received on the patient's invoices in Patient Invoices & Statements during the last 12 months.

When three or more payments were received on the patient's invoices in the last 12 months the relief is 5 percent, when one or two were received in that window it is 2 percent, and when none was received there is none.

| Payments received on the patient's invoices, last 12 months | Relief |
|---|---|
| Three or more | 5 percent |
| One or two | 2 percent |
| None | None |

**Readings (hypothetical).** Exactly three payments in the window: 5 percent. Two: 2 percent. Payments only before the 12-month window: none.
